title: Sri Lanka's Pathirage Stuns Olympic Champ for Gold
summary: Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage pulled off a major upset at the Commonwealth Games, defeating India's Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra to win gold in the men's javelin. Pakistan's top contender Arshad Nadeem suffered an unexpected early exit from the competition. The victory marks a stunning achievement for Pathirage against the heavily favored field.
keywords: javelin, Commonwealth Games, gold medal, upset, athletics
people: Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage, Neeraj Chopra, Arshad Nadeem
caption:
